# RoastPrep

> RoastPrep is a free browser game that teaches SAT vocabulary to students in grades 7–11 (about ages 12–17). Five pets gossip in a group chat about real moments in history; each episode introduces 5 SAT words, then tests them with a look-alike-word "Boss battle", a "Word Cop" misuse check, and one SAT-style reading question. No account, no ads, no cookies. Optional Chinese hints for bilingual families.

## Play
- [Season 1 intro](https://roastprep.com/season1/): how the game works, all 12 episodes.
- [Play Season 1](https://roastprep.com/play/): 12 episodes, 55 SAT words, free.

## Season 1 episodes
- Versailles · 1788: The flattery economy
- Paris · 1789: “Let them eat cake”? Prove it.
- Westbrook High · 2026: Student council election: persona edition
- Newport · 1895: A 70-room “cottage” and other humblebrags
- The Emperor’s New Clothes: Everyone sees it. (Nobody sees it.)
- Bath · 1813: A ball with a LOT of rules (and one terrible matchmaker)
- Hollywood · 1928: Movies learn to talk. Fake life stories do not survive.
- New Jersey · 1938: Martians on the radio. Panic in the newspapers. Wait — which part was real?
- London · 1897: The newspapers say Mark Twain is dead. Mark Twain disagrees.
- Online · 2026: The influencer apology video: three ring lights, perfectly timed tears
- Urbino · 1528: The art of looking effortless (nine hours a day)
- Venice · 1760s · Finale: A whole city in masks. One very tall wig.

## Season 1 words
alarmist, apocryphal, artifice, authentic, candid, complacent, complicit, conform, conspicuous, contrite, contrived, corroborate, credible, credulous, decorum, deign, deliberate, discreet, discrete, disingenuous, dissent, embellish, eminent, endorse, extravagant, fabricate, feign, frugal, hyperbole, hypercritical, hypocritical, imminent, ingenuous, meddlesome, misconstrue, nonchalant, obsequious, obstinate, ostentatious, parsimonious, plausible, pretentious, reticent, retract, sensational, sincere, skeptical, steadfast, superficial, tarnish, ulterior, understated, unfounded, vindicate, wry

- [Privacy policy](https://roastprep.com/privacy.html): no personal information collected from children; progress stays on the device.
- Contact: hello@roastprep.com
